architecture_evidence.retrieval_head_input: final jointly encoded hidden states after all pair-aware cross-chain attention layers

claim_boundary: Train-only architecture and source-capacity audit. Partner swaps are ranking controls, not verified biological noninteractions. No development, test, biological-improvement, or SOTA claim is authorized.
interpretation: The current contrastive embeddings are conditional on the cognate partner because both chains are pooled after joint cross-chain attention. Increasing random candidates from one rank to all eight ranks delayed but did not prevent a near-perfect retrieval shortcut. Candidate-pool scale alone is therefore not a valid production fix.

next_frozen_gate.counterfactual: Score actual partner-swapped joint forwards rather than only mixing embeddings extracted from cognate joint forwards.
false_negative_controls: fixed sampler seed and immutable provenance
next_frozen_gate.retrieval_view: Encode chains without cross-chain attention for the contrastive retrieval objective; retain joint cross-chain encoding for contact and MLM/contact coupling.
next_frozen_gate.source: development-clean high-direct STRING train slice with source endpoint clusters
next_frozen_gate.systems: Run a short train-only pilot only after CPU materialization and a counterfactual partner-swap diagnostic pass.
